procnotices.notice_text:
REQUEST FOR EXPRESSION OF INTEREST

Recruitment of PMU Procurement Consultant (C3-IC2)

The Socialist Republic of Viet Nam has received a grant from the Multilateral Fund for the Implementation of the Montreal Protocol on Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer, administered by the World Bank (WB) and the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP), to implement the Sustainable Management of Substances Controlled by the Montreal Protocol Project (SMS-MP) under Department of Climate Change (DCC) and intends to use part of the grant to cover eligible expenses under this Contract.

The SMS-MP PMU plans to recruit a national individual consultant to implement the PMU Procurement Consultant Contract (C3-IC2) to support the implementation of the Project with the following requirements:

- Relevant university degree in the relevant area of economics, procurement, and finance.

- 10 years of working experience as procurement consultant in ODA/international donors funded projects, preferably WB/ADB funded projects.

- Good understanding on WB (or MDB) procurement rules and procedures. Understanding of general principles of public procurement and approval procedures under the Viet Nam Law on Public Procurement.

- Understanding on procedures and regulations of state government agencies.

- Proficient command of English.

- Proficient use of office software applications.

- Ability to work under pressure, multitask, and meet deadlines.

- In good health.

The PMU will select consultant through an individual consultant selection process in accordance with the World Bank's procurement regulations. Qualified candidates will be invited for an interview at the Project Office.

The TOR for the job can be downloaded at this link: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/1tcLFNmoWdbWUEqrGbaeGoIqvv22PlTUp or via email bdkh_vietnamozone@mae.gov.vn starting from 12 June 2026. Interested candidates are requested to send their CV describing similar tasks and relevant experience to the email address or address below before 12:00 PM on 30 June 2026.

PMU of the Sustainable Management of Substances Controlled by the Montreal Protocol Project (SMS-MP)

Department of Climate Change, Room C904, Building C, Ministry of Agriculture and Environment, No. 10 Ton That Thuyet, Cau Giay Ward, Ha Noi City, Viet Nam

1. CONTEXTE ET JUSTIFICATION

La Commission Nationale des Marchés Publics (CNMP) est l'entité nationale responsable de garantir la conformité, l'efficacité et la transparence dans les processus d'attribution des marchés publics en Haïti. Le nouveau projet de cinq ans (2025-2029), baptisé Projet de Renforcement de la Gestion des Finances Publiques (PReGeFiP), financé par la Banque Mondiale, s'inscrit dans le cadre de la modernisation de la gestion publique et l'amélioration de la gouvernance des finances publiques. Grâce à ce projet, la CNMP envisage à moyen terme la dématérialisation des procédures de passation des marchés publics.

Toutefois, avant d’entamer la mise en œuvre de cette réforme, la CNMP souhaite recruter une firme afin de disposer d’une étude de faisabilité approfondie et d’un cahier des charges qui permettra de déterminer les conditions préalables, les opportunités, les contraintes, les coûts et les implications juridiques, organisationnelles et techniques de la dématérialisation.

Dans le cadre de cette activité de dématérialisation, la CNMP, bénéficiaire du PReGeFIP est le Maître d’ouvrage et le Ministère de l’Économie et des Finances (MEF) agissant par le biais de l’Unité de Coordination de Projets (UCP), assurant la gestion fiduciaire de ce Projet est le Maître d’ouvrage délégué. 

 

2. OBJECTIF GÉNÉRAL DE LA MISSION

L’objectif global de la mission est de réaliser une étude de faisabilité technique et de rédiger un cahier des charges, institutionnelle, juridique et économique en vue d’identifier les meilleures options pour la mise en place d’un système de dématérialisation des procédures de marchés publics en Haïti.

3. OBJECTIFS SPÉCIFIQUES

  -Effectuer une évaluation exhaustive de la situation actuelle

  • Analyser les processus existants de passation des marchés publics en Haïti, y compris leurs forces, faiblesses, et niveaux d’automatisation.

- Évaluer les capacités institutionnelles, humaines, juridiques et techniques

  • Identifier les ressources disponibles et les lacunes à combler pour permettre une transformation numérique réussie.

- Identifier les attentes et besoins des parties prenantes

  • Recueillir les exigences fonctionnelles et techniques auprès des autorités contractantes, opérateurs économiques, régulateurs et autres acteurs concernés.

- Élaborer un cahier des charges complet et détaillé

  • Définir avec précision les besoins fonctionnels, techniques, organisationnels et réglementaires pour la mise en place du système de dématérialisation.

Ce cahier des charges servira de base de référence pour la conception, le développement et le déploiement de la solution.

 - Évaluer les risques et identifier les facteurs clés de succès

  • Prendre en compte les risques techniques, organisationnels et institutionnels pouvant compromettre le projet.
  • Définir les conditions de succès : engagement politique, financement, compétences, accompagnement au changement, etc.

-Concevoir une feuille de route stratégique et pragmatique

  • Établir un plan d’action chiffré, avec des étapes claires, des ressources identifiées, un calendrier réaliste et des indicateurs de performance.

-Préciser l’approche de mise en œuvre itérative du projet

  • Définir le nombre indicatif d’itérations (cycles ou phases) nécessaires pour la conception, le développement, le déploiement et la montée en charge du système.
  • Estimer la durée moyenne de chaque itération ainsi que la durée globale indicative de mise en œuvre du système, en tenant compte des capacités institutionnelles et techniques du pays.

-  Fournir des recommandations concrètes

  • Proposer des outils numériques, plateformes, structures de gouvernance et réformes réglementaires adaptées au contexte haïtien.

4. RÉSULTATS ATTENDUS

-  Diagnostic complet de la situation actuelle

  • Un rapport d’évaluation détaillé décrivant les processus actuels de passation des marchés publics, leurs faiblesses, inefficacités et opportunités d’amélioration.

-Cartographie des capacités existantes

  • Une analyse précise des capacités institutionnelles, humaines, juridiques et techniques disponibles ou manquantes pour réussir la transformation numérique.

-Identification claire des besoins des parties prenantes

  • Un rapport de consultation incluant les besoins spécifiques des acteurs clés : autorités contractantes, opérateurs économiques, régulateurs, etc.

-Cahier des charges fonctionnel et technique élaboré

  • Un document structuré définissant les exigences fonctionnelles, les spécifications techniques, les contraintes réglementaires, et les modalités de mise en œuvre du futur système dématérialisé.

-Analyse des risques et plan d’atténuation

  • Une identification des principaux risques (techniques, humains, institutionnels) accompagnée de stratégies pour les prévenir ou les atténuer.

-Feuille de route stratégique validée

  • Un plan d’action opérationnel, avec un échéancier, une estimation budgétaire, des ressources affectées et des étapes de mise en œuvre définies.

- Recommandations concrètes et applicables

Un ensemble de propositions sur :

  • les outils numériques à adopter (plateformes, logiciels),
  • les modèles de gouvernance à mettre en place,
  • les mécanismes de suivi et d’évaluation à intégrer
  • Le nombre de cycles de développement (itérations) nécessaires pour la conception et la mise en œuvre de l’application de gestion des marchés publics.

-Conditions réunies pour le lancement du projet de dématérialisation

  • Une base solide (technique, juridique, institutionnelle) permettant de passer à la phase de conception et d’exécution du système de dématérialisation.

5. MÉTHODOLOGIE SUGGÉRÉE

La firme proposera une méthodologie détaillée, participative et inclusive, reposant notamment sur les axes suivants :

  • la revue documentaire des cadres juridiques, réglementaires et stratégiques applicables ;
  • l’analyse des initiatives passées et existantes de dématérialisation des marchés publics en Haïti ;
  • des entretiens semi-structurés avec les parties prenantes clés : la CNMP, la CSCCA, le MEF, les autorités contractantes, les opérateurs privés, les partenaires techniques et financiers, … ;
  • des ateliers de concertation et de validation ;
  • des analyses comparatives d’expériences pertinentes dans des pays comparables ;
  • une approche itérative et progressive de mise en œuvre du système, précisant :

 

    1. les différentes itérations envisagées (phase pilote, déploiement progressif, généralisation),
    2. les livrables attendus à l’issue de chaque itération,
    3. les critères de passage d’une phase à la suivante.

 

6. DURÉE DE LA MISSION

La durée de la mission est estimée à cent (100) jours ouvrables sur une période de trois (5) mois, à compter de la validation du contrat.

8. PROFIL DE LA FIRME ET COMPOSITION DE L’ÉQUIPE  

    1. Profil de la firme

La firme devra justifier au moins cinq (5) années d’expérience avérée dans au moins deux des domaines suivants :

  • réforme, régulation ou gestion des systèmes de passation des marchés publics ;
  • mise en œuvre de systèmes d’e-procurement ou de dématérialisation dans le secteur public ;
  • réalisation d’études de faisabilité, de feuilles de route ou de cahiers des charges pour des projets de transformation numérique de l’administration publique.

Une expérience dans des contextes institutionnels vulnérables ou similaires à celui d’Haïti constitue un atout.

    1. Équipe clé minimale  
       
  • Un (1) expert senior en marchés publics
  • Un (1) expert en analyse institutionnelle et gouvernance
  • Un (1) expert en systèmes d’information et transformation numérique
  • Un (1) expert en gestion de projets informatiques et conduite du changement

 

    1. Formation et compétences des experts

Tous les experts devront justifier d’un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 (Master ou équivalent) et d’une expérience professionnelle pertinente.

-Expert senior en marchés publics

  • Expérience professionnelle : au moins 5 ans dans le domaine des marchés publics ;
  • Expérience spécifique : réformes, audits, assistance technique ou projets de dématérialisation des marchés publics ;
  • Connaissance des normes et bonnes pratiques internationales constitue un atout.

- Expert en analyse institutionnelle et gouvernance

  • Expérience professionnelle : au moins 5 ans en analyse institutionnelle, gouvernance publique ou réformes administratives ;
  • Expérience spécifique : projets de modernisation de l’État et coordination interinstitutionnelle ;
  • Expérience avec des projets financés par des partenaires techniques et financiers est souhaitable.

- Expert en systèmes d’information et transformation numérique

  • Expérience professionnelle : au moins 5 ans dans les systèmes d’information et la transformation numérique ;
  • Expérience spécifique : dématérialisation, interopérabilité, sécurité de l’information et protection des données ;
  • Références sur des projets similaires au niveau national ou international souhaitées.

-Expert en gestion de projets informatiques et conduite du changement

  • Expérience professionnelle : au moins 5 ans en gestion de projets informatiques ;
  • Expérience spécifique : montage et structuration de projets de dématérialisation (cadrage du projet, analyse des besoins, définition des processus dématérialisés, élaboration des documents de projet et estimation des coûts, délais et ressources) ;
  • Une certification en gestion de projet constitue un atout.

 

    1. Références antérieures

La firme candidate devra justifier d’une expérience avérée dans la réalisation d’études de faisabilité ou dans l’élaboration de feuilles de route pour des projets de transformation numérique, de préférence dans des contextes comparables à celui d’Haïti.

    1. Connaissance des cadres réglementaires

La firme doit démontrer une bonne maîtrise des pratiques et cadres juridiques relatifs aux marchés publics, en particulier dans des environnements institutionnels similaires.

    1. Capacités techniques et rédactionnelles

Le consultant devra démontrer des aptitudes avérées en analyse, synthèse, communication et rédaction, notamment à travers des exemples de livrables produits dans le cadre de projets similaires (rapports, études, cahiers des charges, etc.).

    1. Compétences linguistiques
      La maîtrise du français est obligatoire. La compréhension du créole haïtien constitue un atout.

9. MODALITÉS DE SUIVI DE LA MISSION

9.1.      Supervision technique

 

Le consultant travaillera sous la supervision directe d’un comité technique de suivi désigné par la CNMP, chargé de valider les livrables à chaque étape.


Des réunions de suivi périodiques seront organisées afin d’assurer la coordination, le suivi des progrès et la validation des livrables intermédiaires.

 

Des réunions régulières seront organisées pour le suivi de la mission, la validation des livrables intermédiaires, et la coordination avec les parties prenantes clés.

 

9.2.      Supervision fiduciaire

 

Sur la base des rapports et livrables approuvés par l’organisme de supervision technique, sous la forme d’une lettre de satisfaction, l’UCP, assure le paiement lié aux documents soumis, accompagnes de la facture correspondante.

 

10. MODALITÉS DE SOUMISSION DES CANDIDATURES

Les firmes intéressées devront soumettre :

    2. méthodologie détaillée,

    4. composition et CV assorti des attestations des études et des expériences déclarées de chaque membre de l’équipe proposée.
  • Une offre financière détaillée (en HTG ou en USD), précisant :
    1. les honoraires par expert,
    2. les coûts liés à l’organisation des ateliers (deux jours au maximum : un jour d’atelier de concertation et un jour d’atelier de validation).
  • Une lettre de motivation.
  • Les références de missions similaires.

  • Paiement échelonné selon les livrables validés
  • La CNMP reste propriétaire de tous les livrables remis
  • Le consultant s’engage à la plus stricte confidentialité sur les données et informations collectées durant la mission.

Assignment Title: Recruitment of an Individual Consultant for the Development of an Operations Manual for The Gambia Social Protection Fund

Procurement Method: Individual Consultant (IC)

Reference No.    GM-CPCU - MOFEA-556571-CS-INDV

1. Background:

The Government of The Gambia has made significant progress in strengthening its social protection system over the past decade. Building on the National Social Protection Policy (2015–2025), the recently approved National Social Protection Policy (2026–2035) provides a comprehensive framework for establishing an inclusive, integrated, and resilient social protection system that addresses poverty, vulnerability, and exposure to shocks across the life cycle. Despite progress, poverty and vulnerability remain significant challenges. A substantial proportion of the population continues to face multidimensional deprivations, particularly in rural areas, with increasing exposure to climate-related and economic shocks. Existing social protection interventions, while impactful, remain fragmented, limited in coverage, and often constrained by short-term and unpredictable financing. In response, the Government has prioritized the establishment of sustainable and institutionalized financing mechanisms as a cornerstone of the social protection system. The Social Protection Act 2024 provides the legal basis for the establishment of the Social Protection Fund (the Fund), which serves as a central financing instrument to support the implementation of priority interventions under the national policy framework.

Against this backdrop, the development of a comprehensive Operations Manual for the Fund is essential to operationalize the provisions of the Act, strengthen governance and accountability, and ensure that resources are allocated and utilized effectively in alignment with national priorities

2. Objectives

The primary objective is to develop a comprehensive, user-friendly, and practical Operations Manual for the Fund that covers all aspects of the Fund’s administration, project financing, and financial management.

2.1 Specific Objectives:

  1. Document the policy framework, institutional arrangements and operational procedures governing the Fund
  2. Develop clear, transparent procedures for fund administration that align with the Social Protection Act and existing regulations
  3. Define clear decision-making criteria and processes that ensure alignment with the Fund’s objectives
  4. Establish linkages between the Fund and coordination tools like the GamSR for targeting and beneficiary identification, GRM, monitoring etc. Tools that support fund.
  5. Clarify the relationship between the Fund and existing programmes
  6. Define the conceptual positioning of the ASP sub-window within the Fund, including its strategic role and linkages to national shock response systems
  7. Provide guidance on the 1% contingency reserve including permitted and prohibited uses
  8. Ensure the manual promotes transparency, accountability and efficient fund utilization

3. Qualification and Experience Requirements

The individual consultant should possess the following:

  • An advanced degree (master’s degree or higher) in social policy, public administration, development economics, or a related field.
  • At least 7 years of professional experience in social protection programme design and implementation.
  • Demonstrated experience in developing operations manuals or comparable institutional documents.
  • Strong knowledge of social fund operations and international best practices.
  • Proven expertise in results-based management, monitoring, and evaluation.
  • Excellent writing and communication skills in English.
  • Experience in facilitation, training, and stakeholder engagement

3.1 Desirable Qualifications

  • Previous experience in West Africa or The Gambia, or a developing economy
  • Knowledge of Gambian social protection system and policies
  • Experience with social registries and targeting systems
  • Knowledge of financial management and procurement procedures
  • Familiarity with MIS for social programmes

4. Assignment Duration:  

The consultancy shall be completed within approximately 10 weeks (50 - 55 working days) from the date of contract signing.

5. Submission of Expressions of Interest:

Expressions of interest should be delivered in a written form to the address below (by email) on or before 1st July 2026 at 12h30 GMT.

Título da consultoria: Contratação de um Gabinete para fiscalizar as obras de Construção de Infraestruturas Sociais (Casas, Escola e respetivo muro de vedação) na Zona de Expansão Segura da Comunidade de Iô Grande, no Distrito de Caué.

 Ref. nº: 73/C/COMP2/WACA+/2026

 

O Governo da República Democrática de S. Tomé e Príncipe, através do Ministério da Economia e Finanças, recebeu um Donativo da Associação Internacional para o Desenvolvimento (IDA), para financiar os custos do Projeto de Resiliência das Áreas Costeiras e Turismo Sustentável (WACA+), e pretende aplicar parte do fundo para pagamentos ao abrigo do contrato para Contratação de um gabinete para fiscalizar as obras de Construção de Infraestruturas Sociais (Casas, Escola e respetivo muro de vedação) na Zona de Expansão Segura da Comunidade de Iô Grande, no Distrito de Caué.

     Os objetivos principais da consultoria se destacam as seguintes:

  • Fiscalização das Construção de Casas sociais, Escola e respetivo muro de Vedação, na ZES de Iô Grande em conformidade com projeto de execução (desenhos técnicos, memória descritiva, mapa de quantidades) e demais documentos técnicos anexos, no âmbito do projeto WACA+, realizada por um Gabinete de engenharia especializado em Estudos e Fiscalização de obras de Construção Civil. A atividade visa assegurar a qualidade técnica dos trabalhos através de monitorização contínua, com visitas regulares de especialistas, relatórios periódicos e presença permanente de um técnico de campo durante toda a execução da consultoria.
  • Apoiar na elaboração do Plano de Gestão Ambiental e Social da construção (PGAS-C) e respetivos sub-planos;
  • Assegurar a monitorização e mitigação dos impactos ambientais e sociais, e a aplicação das respetivas normas ambientais e sociais e Plano de Gestão Ambiental e Social (PGAS) durante a execução das obras.

Os Termos de Referência (ToRs) detalhados podem ser solicitados através dos seguintes endereços eletrónicos: waca.procurement@afap.st , dg.procurement@afap.st.

A Agência Fiduciária de Administração de Projetos convida empresas de consultoria elegíveis (“Consultores”) a manifestarem o seu interesse na prestação dos referidos serviços, mediante o envio de uma carta de intenções. As empresas interessadas devem apresentar informações que comprovem a sua experiência e qualificações relevantes (exe.: folhetos, brochuras institucionais, descrição de contratos similares executados, experiência na região, etc.).

 Os critérios para qualificação do gabinete:

Experiência geral do gabinete

  • Ter pelo menos 10 anos de experiência comprovada em prestação de serviços de fiscalização e supervisão de obras de construção civil;

Experiência específica

  • Ter pelo menos 2 contratos de Fiscalização de obras de construção de infraestruturas sociais (habitações sociais, escolas, etc.) realizados
  •  Ter pelo menos 1 contrato com implementação ou monitorização de PGAS em projeto financiado por banco multilateral
  • Ter pelo menos 5 anos de experiência comprovada em protocolos de VBG/EAS

Capacidade legal

  • Apresentar prova de registo como gabinete de estudos ou empresa de consultoria, válido à data de submissão da proposta

N.B: As informações prestadas devem ser comprovadas mediante junção de respetivos comprovativos.

MINISTRY OF EDUCATION CULTURE & HIGHER EDUCATION

Somalia Education for Human Capital Development Project

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSION OF INTEREST (REOI)

 

Individual Selection of Consultant

Project ID No. P172434

Name of the Project: Somalia Education for Human Capital Development Project

 Consulting Service: FM Specialist

Individual/Firm: Individual

Duty Station: Mogadishu

 

Deadline: 28th June 2026

Ref No. SO-MOECHE-556432-CS-INDV

 

  1. BACKGROUND OF THE PROJECT

 

The Somalia Education for Human Capital Project seeks to enhance the effectiveness of teaching and learning in schools spread across selected regions of the country. The project prioritizes girls’ access, learning conditions, completion rates, and outcomes and uses specific indicators and targets to track and report on these factors. The project targets fourteen districts with the lowest enrollment rates and experience other challenges. To help drive enrollment in these districts, the project is delivering a package of schooling services to benefit disadvantaged, out-of-school children: new schools have been built, teachers will be hired and trained, ands school grants will be given. New schools have been built, teachers have been hired and trained, and school grants have been provided.

 

The Ministry of Education, Culture and Higher Education (MoECHE) intends to hire a qualified Financial Management specialist to be responsible for implementation of financial activities within the Somalia Education for Human Capital Development Project.

 

Responsibilities: The FM specialist will be responsible for Maintaining all accounting records in line with approved accounting standards and in line with the World Bank’s and Government’s regulations and ensure that disbursements are made in accordance with approved annual budgets and work plans together with the Project management. The FM specialist will ensure that all payments are done in accordance with good accounting practices and in line with the project objectives and financing agreement and ensure prompt release of funds once approved to beneficiaries. He/she will ensure that the filing system of the accounting records are always satisfactory, and they are easily retrievable for reviews and audit purposes. The FM specialist will assist in management of fixed assets by ensuring timely update of fixed assets register, and physical verification of assets, at least twice a year, as guided by fixed assets management Policy”.

S/he will undertake all the other specific tasks detailed in the Terms of Reference (TOR) that can be found at the following website   https://jobapplication.moe.gov.so/ or can be provided upon submission of application. 

 

A.  Selection Criteria: The selection shall be based on the qualifications, experience and skills of the candidate and followed by an interview. The qualifications, experience and competencies include:

  1. Master’s degree in accounting, finance, statistics or business administration;
  2. Professional qualification in financial management, registered by and attained final qualification of any financial management related recognized professional body e.g. CIPFA IPFM, ACCA, CPA etc, is desirable.
  3. At least 7 years of experience in audit or financial management;
  4. At least 3 years of experience in financial management directly relevant to public sector and/or international development organization;
  5. Experience of project financial management in a developing country; experience in a fragile state is preferable;
  6. Excellent written and oral communication skills in English and Somali to deliver technical financial documents, and reports.
  7. Excellent computer skills in Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) and Internet use, including database use is required, working experience of FMIS will be an added advantage.

 

B. REPORTING

The FM Specialist will directly report on a day-to-day basis to the PMU Project Manager. He/she will be expected to closely work with the EAFS Director in the Accountant General’s Office, Ministry of Finance and Procurement Specialist to smoothly run project operations.

C. TIMING Duration of Assignment:

The FM specialist shall be contracted for 10 Months period.

The Ministry of Culture and Higher Education (MoECHE) now invites eligible Individual Consultants to indicate their interest in providing these services. Interested Individual Consultants must submit the following: (i) Curriculum Vitae (CV) with 3 reference persons; (ii) copies of certificates of academic qualifications; and (iii) cover letter indicating that they are qualified to perform the services.

D.  SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to section III, para 3.14,3.16 & 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers: Procurement in Investment Projects Financing Goods, Works, Non -Consulting and Consulting Services, July 2016, revised November 2017, August 2018 and November 2020, and September 2023, (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.  

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Individual Consultant method set out in the World Bank Procurement Regulations. 

Interested Consultants may obtain further information at the address given below from 8:30 to 3.30 pm Mogadishu time (Excluding public holidays).

The Expressions of interest (EOI), CV with 3 reference persons and certificates of academic qualifications must be delivered (in person to the address below or by clicking the following link:  https://jobapplication.moe.gov.so/  by 28th, June, 2026 at 12:00 Hours (Mogadishu Time) – marked clearly as “FM Specialist- Somalia Education for Human Capital Development Project.

procnotices.notice_text:
APPEL A MANIFESTATIONS D’INTÉRÊT

(SERVICES DE CONSULTANT – SELECTION DE FIRMES)

N°04/2026/ProAGRI

 

Pays : République du TCHAD               

Numéro du Don : E3170

ID du Projet : P179238                            

Projet : Projet d’Agrobusiness et de Transformation Rurale Inclusive (ProAGRI).

Intitulé de la Mission : Recrutement d’un cabinet /bureau d’études chargé de l’Élaboration d’un Plan Stratégique Opérationnel et du Plan d’Actions pour le Développement de l’Agro-industrie du Projet Agrobusiness et de Transformation Rurale Inclusive (ProAGRI).

 

Le Gouvernement de la République du Tchad a reçu un financement de la Banque mondiale pour couvrir le coût du Projet d’Agrobusiness et de Transformation Rurale Inclusive (ProAGRI) et a l’intention d’utiliser une partie de ce financement pour effectuer des paiements au titre du Marché de Recrutement d’un cabinet/bureau d’études chargé de l’Élaboration d’un Plan Stratégique Opérationnel et du Plan d’Actions pour le Développement de l’Agro-industrie du Projet ProAGRI. Le projet s’inscrit dans la Vision 2030 et le PND du Gouvernement du Tchad en vue d’améliorer la résilience, la compétitivité et l’inclusion des chaines de valeur agricoles dans plusieurs provinces du pays.

 

Pour accompagner la vision de transformation rurale du Tchad, le projet ProAGRI, en tant que catalyseur du développement agricole, prévoit de recruter un cabinet d’experts chargé de mener un diagnostic approfondi, d’élaborer un Plan stratégique opérationnel (PSO) pour le développement de l’agro-industrie, assorti d’un Plan d’Actions détaillé, et basé sur un processus national de concertation. Ce plan doit servir de feuille de route fédératrice pour les acteurs publics, le secteur privé, les partenaires techniques et financiers (PTF) et les organisations de producteurs.

 

L’objectif principal de la mission du Consultant est d’élaborer un Plan stratégique opérationnel complet, réaliste et aligné sur les priorités nationales, accompagné d’un Plan d’Actions hiérarchisé pour le développement intégré, durable et compétitif du secteur agro-industriel au Tchad.

 

Les objectifs spécifiques sont :

 

  1. Réaliser une analyse approfondie de l’état actuel de l’agro-industrie au Tchad (diagnostic institutionnel, économique, technique et organisationnel).
  2. Identifier les opportunités économiques, les contraintes majeures et les leviers de croissance du secteur.
  3. Analyser les chaînes de valeur prioritaires (maïs, sésame, arachide, produits horticoles, produits d’élevage, etc.).
  4. Proposer un cadre stratégique incitatif clair incluant vision, objectifs, axes stratégiques et orientations de développement.
  5. Élaborer un Plan d’Actions opérationnel avec priorités, coûts estimatifs, indicateurs, séquencement et responsabilités institutionnelles.
  6. Concevoir et animer 3 ateliers provinciaux de concertation dans des pôles agro-industriels représentatifs.
  7. Organiser et animer un atelier national de validation.
  8. Intégrer toutes les contributions et produire la version finale consolidée du Plan stratégique et de son Plan d’Actions.

 

La Composition de dossier de manifestation d’intérêt est comme suit :

 

  • Une lettre de manifestation d’intérêt adressée à Monsieur le Coordonnateur Nationale du ProAGRI ;
  • En cas de groupement, un accord ou un projet d’accord de groupement signée et cachetée ;
  • Une présentation du cabinet faisant ressortir notamment les domaines de compétences du cabinet ;
  • Les références de missions similaires du cabinet en lien avec la mission projetée ;

 

NB : les références de missions similaires seront justifiées par les pages de garde et de signature des contrats, conventions ou protocoles ainsi que les attestations de service fait ou de bonne fin d’exécution en cohérence avec les prestations similaires exécutées et citées dans la liste des prestations exécutées.

 

En cas d'ex-aequo, le volume des expériences pertinentes justifiées sera utilisé comme critère additionnel pour le classement final des consultants.

 

A l'issue de l'évaluation des manifestations d'intérêt, le consultant présentant le meilleur niveau de qualification et d'expérience en rapport avec la mission sera invité à soumettre une proposition technique et financière.

 

La durée prévisionnelle de la mission est soixante (60) jours calendaires, incluant le diagnostic, les ateliers, la rédaction et la validation.

 

Le recrutement du consultant se fera suivant la méthode de Sélection sur la qualification des consultants avec approche ouverte (Publication), conformément au Règlement de passation des marchés pour les emprunteurs sollicitant le financement de projets d’investissement (FPI), révisé en Septembre 2025. Les candidats doivent être exempts de tout risque de conflits d’intérêt au regard des dispositions de l’article 3.16.d. et 3.22.d de ce Règlement.

 

Les expressions d’intérêt doivent être déposées sous pli fermé comprenant trois (3) exemplaires dont un original, toutes placées dans une même enveloppe ou transmises par courrier électronique à l’adresse mentionnée ci-dessous, au plus tard le 07 juillet 2026 à 15 H 00 mn (TU + 1) et porter expressément la mention : A l’Attention du Coordonnateur National du ProAGRI « Recrutement d’un cabinet /bureau d’études chargé de l’Élaboration d’un Plan Stratégique Opérationnel et du Plan d’Actions pour le Développement de l’Agro-industrie du Projet Agrobusiness et de Transformation Rurale Inclusive (ProAGRI)».

 

L’adresse de dépôt physique des manifestations d’intérêt est la suivante : UCP du ProAGRI, sise à l’Avenue Abbass Koty Yacoub, Quartier Farcha (à 300 m au Nord-Est de ORCA) ;  L’adresse de dépôt par voie électronique est la suivante : proagritchad@outlook.com;  abdallahgoroumimahamat@gmail.com;  mhtnaim61@gmail.com.

 

 

 

Le Coordonnateur National du ProAGRI

 

 

 

 

    MAHAMAT ABDALLAH GOROUMI

Projeto de Resiliência das Zonas Costeiras e Turismo Sustentável de STP

 

 

                       PEDIDO DE MANIFESTAÇÃO DE INTERESSE

              (SERVIÇOS DE CONSULTORIA - SELEÇÃO DE GABINETE)

 

 

PAÍS: São Tomé e Príncipe

PROJETO: Projeto de Resiliência das Zonas Costeira e Turismo Sustentável de STP (WACA+)

Título da consultoria: Contratação de Gabinete para Fiscalização das Obras de Remodelação das instalações da Direção Geral do Turismo e Hotelaria, na cidade de São Tomé.

 Ref. nº: 72/C/COMP2/WACA+/2026

 

O Governo da República Democrática de S. Tomé e Príncipe, através do Ministério da Economia e Finanças, recebeu um Donativo da Associação Internacional para o Desenvolvimento (IDA), para financiar os custos do Projeto de Resiliência das Áreas Costeiras e Turismo Sustentável (WACA+), e pretende aplicar parte do fundo para pagamentos ao abrigo do contrato para Contratação de Gabinete para Fiscalização das Obras de Remodelação das instalações da Direção Geral do Turismo e Hotelaria, na cidade de São Tomé.

     Os objetivos principais da consultoria se destacam as seguintes:

  • Fiscalização das obras de Remodelação nas instalações da DGTH, na cidade de São Tomé, em conformidade com projeto de execução (desenhos técnicos, memória descritiva, mapa de quantidades e demais documentos técnicos anexos, no âmbito do projeto WACA+, realizada por um Gabinete de engenharia especializado em Estudos e Fiscalização de obras de construção Civil. A atividade visa assegurar a qualidade técnica dos trabalhos através de monitorização contínua, com visitas regulares de especialistas, relatórios periódicos e presença permanente de um técnico de campo durante toda a execução da consultoria.
  • Apoiar na elaboração do Plano de Gestão Ambiental e Social da construção (PGAS-C) e respetivos sub-planos;
  • Assegurar a monitorização e mitigação dos impactos ambientais e sociais, e a aplicação das respetivas normas ambientais e sociais e Plano de Gestão Ambiental e Social (PGAS) durante a execução das obras.

Os Termos de Referência (ToRs) detalhados podem ser solicitados através dos seguintes endereços eletrónicos: waca.procurement@afap.st , dg.procurement@afap.st.

A Agência Fiduciária de Administração de Projetos convida gabinetes de consultoria elegíveis (“Consultores”) a manifestarem o seu interesse na prestação dos referidos serviços, mediante o envio de uma carta de intenções. As empresas interessadas devem apresentar informações que comprovem a sua experiência e qualificações relevantes (exe.: folhetos, brochuras institucionais, descrição de contratos similares executados, experiência na região, etc.).

 Os critérios para qualificação do gabinete:

Experiência geral do gabinete

  • Ter pelo menos 10 anos de experiência comprovada em prestação de serviços de fiscalização e supervisão de obras de construção civil;

Experiência específica

  • Ter pelo menos 2 contratos de Fiscalização de obras de remodelação de edifícios públicos realizados
  •  Ter pelo menos 1 contrato com implementação ou monitorização de PGAS em projeto financiado por banco multilateral
  • Ter pelo menos 5 anos de experiência comprovada em protocolos de VBG/EAS

Capacidade legal

  • Apresentar prova de registo como gabinete de estudos ou empresa de consultoria, válido à data de submissão da proposta

N.B: As informações prestadas devem ser comprovadas mediante junção de respetivos comprovativos.

Chama-se a atenção para os parágrafos, 3.14, 3.16 e 3.17 da Seção III do “Regulamento de Aquisições de Mutuários do IPF” do Banco Mundial (edição de Setembro 2025) que definem a Política sobre conflitos de interesse.

Os gabinetes podem associar-se para reforçar as suas qualificações, mas devem indicar claramente se a associação se dá na forma de um consórcio e/ou subcontratação. No caso de consórcio, a proposta deve indicar claramente os parceiros e o tipo de associação (consórcio ou subcontratação). Em caso de consórcio, todos os membros responderão, conjunta e solidariamente pela execução do contrato, se selecionados.

Recomenda-se que as Manifestações de Interesse não excedam 30 páginas (excluindo os anexos institucionais, que não serão contabilizados nesse limite).  

A seleção do gabinete será realizada segundo o método de “Seleção Baseada nas Qualificações do Consultor, conforme estabelecido no “Regulamento de Aquisições do Banco Mundial para Mutuários do Financiamento de Projetos de Investimento (FPI)”, edição de Setembro de 2025.

Informações adicionais podem ser obtidas no endereço abaixo durante o horário de expediente (das 08h00 às 16h00).

As manifestações de interesse deverão ser entregues até o dia 26 de Junho de 2026, às 23h59 (hora local), por via eletrónica - waca.procurement@afap.st, dg.procurement@afap.st - ou presencialmente no endereço abaixo, mencionando o seguinte assunto: “Manifestação de Interesse Ref. nº 72/C/COMP2/WACA+/2026 Contratação de Gabinete para Fiscalização das Obras de Remodelação das instalações da Direção Geral do Turismo e Hotelaria, na cidade de São Tomé.

Package No. (according to the Procurement Plan): UZ-INSON-CS-IC-2.1.10.1.

 

The Republic of Uzbekistan has received financing from the World Bank for the implementation of the project “Innovative Social Protection System for Inclusion of Vulnerable Populations” (INSON) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services (“Services”) include the provision of expert support to the National Agency for Social Protection under the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan in the development, standardization and piloting of a package of social services within the NASP system for the provision of hospice and home-based palliative care, as well as in supporting institutional development, interagency coordination and preparation of practical implementation mechanisms.

The Consultant will provide expert support in the following areas: conducting a structured assessment of the existing hospice and home-based palliative care system; analysis of legislation, regulatory, financial and institutional mechanisms; development of a national model and target operational configuration of hospice and home-based palliative care services; preparation of recommendations on the functions and procedures for interaction among “Inson” Centers, medical institutions, hospices, patronage nurses, local government authorities, non-governmental organizations and service providers; development of referral mechanisms, assessment criteria and criteria for provision of services to persons in need of palliative care; development of service standards, including minimum requirements, quality criteria, staffing requirements, assessment and referral criteria, service delivery procedures, monitoring indicators, patient safety requirements and ethical safeguards; development of standard operating procedures, a matrix of roles and responsibilities, checklists, methodological guidelines, monitoring, quality assessment and accountability mechanisms; development of a draft integrated package of social and medical services for persons in need of palliative care; preparation of a training program, training materials, practical exercises and case studies, as well as delivery of one-time training for at least 300 participants selected by NASP from among the staff of “Inson” Centers and partner organizations; participation in piloting in selected regions and preparation of the final package of documents incorporating the pilot results.

The estimated scope of work is 60 working days over a period of 6 months, including 12 working days allocated for training the staff of “Inson” Centers. The expected commencement date of the assignment is June 2026. All work must be completed no later than October 2026.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) can be found at the following link:

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1oSfo_OGo1j8G3mKxi_N5XUOhdxXVZRRi/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=104755491226149341341&rtpof=true&sd=true

The National Agency for Social Protection (NASP) under the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan invites qualified individuals (“Consultants”) to express their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants must provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services (attach a CV describing experience in similar positions, under similar conditions, etc.). Employees of firms may express interest in performing the assignment through their employer firm; in such case, only the experience and qualifications of the candidates shall be taken into account in the selection process.

Selection criteria for the Consultant:

Education and academic qualification: higher education / degree in social protection, social work or healthcare, with experience in hospice and palliative care management. An academic degree in palliative care will be an advantage.

Professional experience: at least 5 years of practical experience in palliative care service design, systems management or social care program development, including case management, service coordination and interagency cooperation.

Experience in developing and implementing documents: demonstrated experience in developing and implementing regulatory, methodological and operational documents for social or palliative care processes, including standard operating procedures, matrices of roles and responsibilities, service level agreements or service level indicators, checklists and methodological guidelines.

Methodological experience: demonstrated experience in developing and/or applying methodologies for social or palliative care.

Experience in comprehensive assessment, ethics and confidentiality: experience in organizing comprehensive assessments, including psychological, medical and social-functional assessment, as well as experience in ethics, confidentiality, obtaining consent and protection of personal data will be an advantage.

Experience in training and capacity building: experience in conducting training, training of trainers, supervision, mentoring, methodological support and strengthening the capacity of staff in integrated social service networks will be an advantage.

Experience in interagency cooperation: experience in cooperation with medical institutions, local government authorities, non-governmental organizations and service providers.

Knowledge of international approaches and standards: knowledge of international approaches and standards in hospice and palliative care, including approaches of the World Health Organization and comparable international models.

International / regional experience: experience in cooperation with government authorities in Central Asian countries will be an advantage.

Additional relevant experience: experience in developing, managing or advising on hospice/palliative care programs or systems for provision of such services, including palliative care service design and systems strengthening, will be an advantage.

The attention of interested Consultants, including firms, is drawn to paragraphs 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers dated September 2023 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

Additional information can be obtained at the address below during working hours from 09:00 to 18:00 (Tashkent time).

REPÚBLICA DE MOÇAMBIQUE

MINISTÉRIO DAS COMUNICAÇÕES E TRANSFORMAÇÃO DIGITAL

Projecto de Aceleração Digital de Moçambique

 

SOLICITAÇÃO DE MANIFESTAÇÃO DE INTERESSE

(CONSULTOR INDIVIDUAL)

 

Contratação de Serviço de Consultoria Individual para Revisão do Plano de Segurança e Elaboração do Plano de Acção de Segurança do PADIM

 

PROJECTO ID: P176459

Ref.: 160/MCTD-PADIM/CS-IC/2026

 

  1. O Ministério das Comunicações e Transformação Digital (MCTD) recebeu um financiamento do Banco Mundial para implementação de um Projecto denominado Aceleração Digital de Moçambique e, pretende aplicar parte dos fundos para a Contratação de Consultor Individual para Revisão do Plano de Segurança e Elaboração do Plano de Acção de Segurança do PADIM.
  2. A presente consultoria tem como objetivo principal apoiar na actualização da análise de risco de segurança, na revisão e operacionalização do Plano de Gestão de Segurança (PGS) do PADIM, bem como no fortalecimento institucional da PIU/UCP e das Instituições Beneficiárias (IBs), através da implementação de acções de capacitação, do estabelecimento de protocolos institucionais de coordenação e da definição de mecanismos de articulação com entidades de defesa, segurança e inteligência, tanto ao nível central como provincial.
  3. De entre outras, o consultor será responsável pelas seguintes tarefas:
  1. Realizar actualizações das avaliações dos riscos de segurança nas áreas de implementação do PADIM, com particular enfoque na região Norte (Província de Cabo Delgado, norte de Nampula e sudeste de Niassa), identificando ameaças e vulnerabilidades associadas ao contexto de fragilidade, conflito e violência, incluindo riscos para colaboradores, activos e operações do projecto;
  2. Desenvolver o Plano de Gestão de Segurança para o Projecto, propondo medidas específicas e proporcionais para mitigar os riscos identificados (Medidas preventivas; Protocolos de segurança no local; Coordenação com autoridades locais; Diretrizes para empreiteiros), em conformidade com os requisitos do Banco Mundial (NAS4) e do Governo de Moçambique;
  3. Estabelecer um sistema contínuo de monitoria da segurança, incluindo indicadores de desempenho e mecanismos periódicos de reporte sobre a evolução dos riscos e medidas implementadas. O sistema deverá prever o uso de metodologias adaptativas de recolha e validação de informação, incluindo colecta remota de dados de segurança, utilização de dados secundários e articulação com parceiros locais relevantes, tais como Polícia da República de Moçambique, Forças de Defesa e Segurança, autoridades locais, actores comunitários e outras entidades institucionais, particularmente em áreas onde o acesso esteja condicionado por razões de segurança;
  4. Desenvolver materiais de formação e conduzir acções de capacitação dirigidas à PIU/UCP, Instituições Beneficiárias, pontos focais provinciais, equipas do projecto e demais stakeholders locais, promovendo boas práticas de segurança, segurança comunitária e o respeito pelos direitos humanos. As capacitações deverão abranger, entre outros aspectos: Plano de Gestão de Segurança; procedimentos de emergência; protocolos de comunicação institucional; gestão de incidentes; procedimentos de acesso a áreas de risco; gestão de informação sensível; coordenação com entidades de defesa e segurança; princípios de segurança comunitária; prevenção de conflitos; e mecanismos de protecção de trabalhadores e comunidades;
  5. Assegurar produção de Protocolos de comunicação que facilite a articulação com Forças de Defesa e Segurança, autoridades locais, organizações relevantes e demais partes interessadas, facilitando a comunicação e coordenação entre os intervenientes, de modo a garantir uma resposta eficaz e atempada a incidentes de segurança.
  1. Por conseguinte, o MCTD, através do Projecto de Aceleração Digital, convida consultores individuais elegíveis a manifestarem seu interesse no provimento dos serviços acima mencionados. Os consultores interessados deverão apresentar, na altura da candidatura, uma carta de manifestação de interesse com Curriculum Vitae e os documentos comprovativos das suas habilidades e experiência profissional (exemplos de trabalhos similares realizados).
  2. Os consultores interessados devem possuir as seguintes qualificações: i) grau de Licenciatura em Estudos de Defesa e Segurança, Gestão de Riscos, Ciências Sociais, Relações internacionais ou áreas afins; ii) Experiência mínima de oito (08) anos em gestão de risco de segurança, resolução de conflitos, prevenção de criminalidade ou actuação em contextos de emergência, assistência humanitária e gestão de riscos de segurança, tanto no sector público como privado, iii) Experiência mínima de cinco (05) anos na elaboração de avaliações de risco de segurança e planos de gestão de segurança no norte de Moçambique (Cabo Delgado, Nampula ou Niassa), bem como experiência na implementação de Planos de Gestão de Segurança (PGS) e integração de riscos de segurança em projectos de infraestrutura, tais como telecomunicações, energia e obras públicas; iv) Experiência mínima de cinco (05) de trabalho em contextos de conflito ou pós-conflito, ambientes de insegurança ou operações de segurança; v) Experiência em coordenação com múltiplos stakeholders e trabalho em equipas multidisciplinares.
  3. Chama – se atenção aos consultores interessados para a Secção III, parágrafos 3.14,3.16 e 3.17 do Regulamento de Aquisições para os Mutuários do “IPF” do Banco Mundial de Julho de 2016, revisto em Setembro de 2023, estabelecendo a política do Banco Mundial sobre o conflito de interesse.
  4. O consultor será seleccionado de acordo com o método de selecção para Consultores Individuais – método estabelecido no Regulamento de Aquisições do Banco Mundial, datado de Setembro de 2023.  
  5. Os consultores interessados poderão obter os Termos de Referência detalhados no endereço abaixo ou solicitar uma cópia electrônica através do seguinte endereço electrônico: procurement@padim.gov.mz  das 08:30 às 15:00 horas antes da data de encerramento.
  6.  As Manifestações de Interesse deverão ser entregues no endereço abaixo até às 15:00 horas do dia 29 de Junho de 2026.

procnotices.notice_text:
APPEL A MANIFESTATIONS D’INTÉRÊT

(SERVICES DE CONSULTANT – SELECTION DE FIRMES)

N°06/2026/ProAGRI

 

Pays : République du TCHAD               

Numéro du Don : E3170

ID du Projet : P179238                            

Projet : Projet d’Agrobusiness et de Transformation Rurale Inclusive (ProAGRI).

Intitulé de la Mission : Recrutement d’un cabinet /bureau d’études chargé de l’Elaboration et de l’Adoption d’une Loi sur la Pêche Commerciale et ses Textes d’Application pour le compte du Projet Agrobusiness et de Transformation Rurale Inclusive (ProAGRI).

 

Le Gouvernement de la République du Tchad a reçu un financement de la Banque mondiale pour couvrir le coût du Projet d’Agrobusiness et de Transformation Rurale Inclusive (ProAGRI) et a l’intention d’utiliser une partie de ce financement pour effectuer des paiements au titre du Marché de Recrutement d’un cabinet /bureau d’études chargé de l’Elaboration et de l’Adoption d’une Loi sur la Pêche Commerciale et ses Textes d’Application pour le compte du Projet ProAGRI.

 

Le Tchad dispose d’importantes ressources halieutiques, notamment grâce à ses zones lacustres et fluviales (Lac Tchad, Batha, Chari-Logone, Salamat, etc.). Ces ressources jouent un rôle essentiel dans :

 

  • La sécurité alimentaire et nutritionnelle des populations ;
  • La création d’emplois et de revenus pour les pêcheurs ;
  • Le commerce local, national et transfrontalier ;
  • La diversification économique rurale.

 

Cependant, le secteur de la pêche commerciale tchadienne est confronté à plusieurs défis :

 

  • Absence ou obsolescence du cadre juridique existant ;
  • Pratiques de pêche non réglementées ou destructrices ;
  • Faible contrôle des zones de pêche et des périodes d’exploitation ;
  • Conflits d’usage entre pêcheurs, éleveurs et autres usagers ;
  • Manque de structuration des acteurs et de la filière ;
  • Absence de textes modernes encadrant la chaîne de commercialisation ;
  • Dégradation progressive des écosystèmes aquatiques.

 

Afin de réguler le secteur, renforcer la gouvernance halieutique, préserver les ressources et promouvoir une pêche durable et commercialement viable, il est nécessaire d’élaborer une Loi moderne sur la pêche commerciale accompagnée de ses décrets et arrêtés d’application. Cette loi doit couvrir non seulement la capture, mais aussi la post-capture (transport, transformation, exportation).

 

L’objectif global de la mission du Consultant est d’élaborer un projet de Loi moderne, cohérent et conforme aux normes régionales et internationales, régissant la pêche commerciale au Tchad, accompagné de ses textes d’application, et validé à travers un processus participatif incluant des ateliers provinciaux et un atelier national.

 

Les objectifs spécifiques sont :

  • Réaliser un diagnostic multidimensionnel et stratégique : Analyser le cadre juridique et institutionnel actuel, identifier les contraintes des chaînes de valeur de la pêche commerciale et intégrer les meilleures pratiques internationales en matière de gouvernance durable.
  • Produire un corpus juridique complet et harmonisé : Élaborer le projet de Loi  sur la pêche commerciale (incluant le régime des licences, le contrôle et les sanctions) ainsi que l'ensemble de ses textes d'application  (décrets, arrêtés, procédures techniques) pour garantir la sécurité juridique du secteur.
  • Conduire le processus de concertation territoriale et inclusive : Préparer et animer les ateliers de concertation dans les pôles provinciaux afin de recueillir les contributions des acteurs locaux, des collectivités et des organisations professionnelles.
  • Assurer la validation nationale et la finalisation des outils : Animer l'atelier national de validation avec toutes les parties prenantes institutionnelles et produire les versions finales consolidées, prêtes à être transmises aux instances gouvernementales pour adoption.

La Composition de dossier de manifestation d’intérêt est comme suit :

 

  • Une lettre de manifestation d’intérêt adressée à Monsieur le Coordonnateur Nationale du ProAGRI ;
  • En cas de groupement, un accord ou un projet d’accord de groupement signée et cachetée ;
  • Une présentation du cabinet faisant ressortir notamment les domaines de compétences du cabinet ;
  • Les références de missions similaires du cabinet en lien avec la mission projetée ;

 

NB : les références de missions similaires seront justifiées par les pages de garde et de signature des contrats, conventions ou protocoles ainsi que les attestations de service fait ou de bonne fin d’exécution en cohérence avec les prestations similaires exécutées et citées dans la liste des prestations exécutées.

 

En cas d'ex-aequo, le volume des expériences pertinentes justifiées sera utilisé comme critère additionnel pour le classement final des consultants.

A l'issue de l'évaluation des manifestations d'intérêt, le consultant présentant le meilleur niveau de qualification et d'expérience en rapport avec la mission sera invité à soumettre une proposition technique et financière.

 

La durée indicative de la mission est de quarante-cinq (45) jours calendaires, incluant diagnostic, rédaction, ateliers et finalisation.

 

Le recrutement du consultant se fera suivant la méthode de Sélection sur la qualification des consultants avec approche ouverte nationale (Publication), conformément au Règlement de passation des marchés pour les emprunteurs sollicitant le financement de projets d’investissement (FPI), révisé en Septembre 2025. Les candidats doivent être exempts de tout risque de conflits d’intérêt au regard des dispositions de l’article 3.16.d. et 3.22.d de ce Règlement.

 

Les expressions d’intérêt doivent être déposées sous pli fermé comprenant trois (3) exemplaires dont un original, toutes placées dans une même enveloppe ou transmises par courrier électronique à l’adresse mentionnée ci-dessous, au plus tard le 09 juillet 2026 à 15 H 00 mn (TU + 1) et porter expressément la mention : A l’Attention du Coordonnateur National du ProAGRI « Recrutement d’un cabinet /bureau d’études chargé de l’Elaboration et de l’Adoption d’une Loi sur la Pêche Commerciale et ses Textes d’Application pour le compte du Projet ProAGRI».

 

L’adresse de dépôt physique des manifestations d’intérêt est la suivante : UCP du ProAGRI, sise à l’Avenue Abbass Koty Yacoub, Quartier Farcha (à 300 m au Nord-Est de ORCA) ; 

 

L’adresse de dépôt par voie électronique est la suivante : proagritchad@outlook.com;  abdallahgoroumimahamat@gmail.com;  mhtnaim61@gmail.com.

 

NB : Seuls les consultants établis en dehors de N'Djamena (Tchad) sont priés de transmettre leurs dossiers par courriel.

Le Coordonnateur National du ProAGRI

    MAHAMAT ABDALLAH GOROUMI

procnotices.notice_text:
CIM - AMFRI

Consórcio Intermunicipal Multifinalitário da Região da AMFRI

Integrated Sustainable Mobility Project at the Mouth of the Itajaí River (PROMOBIS)

P178557

GENERAL PROCUREMENT NOTICE (GPN)

Institution: International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) / World Bank

Country: Brazil

Project: Integrated Sustainable Mobility Project at the Mouth of the Itajaí River (PROMOBIS)

Sector: Transport / Urban Mobility

Loan Number: IBRD-96710

Project ID: P178557

Approval by the World Bank Board of Executive Directors: April 12, 2024

Expected Closing Date: December 31, 2031

The CIM-AMFRI (Consórcio Intermunicipal Multifinalitário da Região da AMFRI) will receive a loan equivalent to US$ 90,000,000.00 (ninety million US Dollars) from the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD / World Bank), Loan IBRD-96710, and intends to apply these funds toward payments for works, goods, non-consulting services, and consulting services under the Integrated Sustainable Mobility Project at the Mouth of the Itajaí River (PROMOBIS). The Project also includes a minimum local counterpart contribution of US$ 30,000,000.00 (thirty million US Dollars), totaling US$ 120,000,000.00 (one hundred and twenty million US Dollars) in public funds. Procurement will be carried out by the Project Coordination Unit (PROMOBIS PCU), which is responsible for fiduciary management and for compliance with the World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers (Fifth Edition – September 2023), and will be open to all bidders from eligible countries.

The objective of the Project is to improve accessibility and mobility in an inclusive and low-emission manner in selected areas of the Mouth of the Itajaí River Region, in the State of Santa Catarina, Brazil.

To achieve this objective, the Project is structured into four Components:

  • Component 1 – Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) and Improvement of the Regional Public Transport System (BRT-AMFRI) (Funds: US$ 66 million, of which US$ 43 million from IBRD and US$ 23 million in local counterpart funds): Implementation of an integrated, dedicated-lane BRT system along the Central Corridor and the Circular Corridor connecting the municipalities of Balneário Camboriú, Camboriú, Itajaí, and Navegantes; four mixed-traffic bus corridors; a 70 km network of road-safety and non-motorized infrastructure interventions (segregated cycle paths, on-street cycle lanes, and sidewalks); an operational control center integrated with disaster risk management; and complementary accessibility and gender-inclusion measures. In addition, up to US$ 42 million in private investment is estimated through Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs) for the operation of the BRT and the acquisition of an electric fleet.

 

  • Component 2 – Technical Assistance for the proposed River Tunnel between Itajaí and Navegantes (Funds: US$ 8 million, of which US$ 4 million from IBRD and US$ 4 million in local counterpart funds): Studies and technical assistance for the design of the immersed tunnel under the Itajaí-Açú River, including: demand studies and an Origin-Destination (OD) Matrix with a gender and social perspective; basic engineering designs, geotechnical studies, and risk matrices; road-safety and gender audits; and Public-Private Partnership (PPP) structuring studies for the concession of the tunnel.

 

  • Component 3 – Active Mobility Connections – Pedestrian Corridors, Safe School Routes, and Cycle Paths in Balneário Camboriú (Funds: US$ 38 million, of which US$ 35 million from IBRD and US$ 3 million in local counterpart funds): Investments in active mobility infrastructure for pedestrians, cyclists, and electric micromobility users, connecting economically vulnerable areas of Balneário Camboriú to employment centers and services along the waterfront, with universal accessibility, pedestrian corridors, safe school routes, and resilient cycle paths.

 

  • Component 4 – Support for Institutional Strengthening and Project Management (Funds: US$ 8 million from IBRD): Support to the Project Coordination Unit (PCU), including integrated regional planning, management of PPPs and concessions, strengthening of internal control, a project management platform, MaaS (Mobility as a Service), a diagnostic assessment for the capacity building of vulnerable populations, and project monitoring and evaluation.

Procurement of contracts financed by the World Bank will be carried out in accordance with the World Bank Procurement Regulations for Investment Project Financing (IPF) Borrowers and will be open to all bidders from eligible countries, as defined in those regulations. The selection methods envisaged include: Request for Proposals (Design and Build), Request for Bids (RFB), Request for Quotations (RFQ), Quality- and Cost-Based Selection (QCBS), Least-Cost Selection (LCS), Quality-Based Selection (QBS), Consultants' Qualifications-Based Selection (CQS), Direct Selection, and Selection of Individual Consultants, as established in the Project's Procurement Plan approved by the World Bank. It should be noted that the formalization of any contract will only take place after the signing of the Loan Agreement between the World Bank and CIM-AMFRI.

As they become available, Specific Procurement Notices (SPN) and Requests for Expressions of Interest (REOI) for individual contracts will be published in the World Bank's STEP (Systematic Tracking of Exchanges in Procurement), in the Official Gazette, and through the other means of publication provided for in the regulations of the World Bank and of CIM-AMFRI, such as the Official Gazette of the State of Santa Catarina, newspapers circulating in the AMFRI region, and the Project's social media channels.

Bidders, consultants, subcontractors, and their respective agents must strictly observe paragraphs 3.14 to 3.18 of Section III of the World Bank Procurement Regulations for Investment Project Financing (IPF) Borrowers, Fifth Edition, September 2023, which set out the World Bank's policy on conflict of interest, as well as the eligibility rules set out in paragraphs 3.21 to 3.24 of the same Section and the provisions on Fraud and Corruption set out in Annex IV of the said Regulations, and the provisions of the Project's Code of Conduct (link: https://cim-amfri.sc.gov.br/pagina-45496/).

Eligible bidders and consultants interested in being included in the list to receive requests for prequalification, bidding, or expressions of interest for consulting contracts, as well as any party interested in obtaining additional information about the Project, may contact the Project Coordination Unit (PROMOBIS PCU).

CIM - AMFRI

Projeto Integrado de Mobilidade Sustentável na Foz do Rio Itajaí (PROMOBIS)

P178557

AVISO GERAL DE AQUISIÇÕES (AGA)

Instituição: Banco Internacional para Reconstrução e Desenvolvimento (BIRD) / Banco Mundial

País: Brasil

Projeto: Projeto Integrado de Mobilidade Sustentável na Foz do Rio Itajaí (PROMOBIS)

Setor: Transporte / Mobilidade Urbana

Número do Empréstimo: IBRD-96710

ID do Projeto: P178557

Aprovação pelo Conselho de Diretores Executivos do Banco Mundial: 12 de abril de 2024

Data de Encerramento Prevista: 31 de dezembro de 2031

O CIM-AMFRI (Consórcio Intermunicipal Multifinalitário da Região da AMFRI) receberá um empréstimo equivalente a US$ 90.000.000,00 (noventa milhões de Dólares) do Banco Internacional para Reconstrução e Desenvolvimento (BIRD / Banco Mundial), Empréstimo IBRD-96710, e se propõe a utilizar esses recursos para o pagamento de obras, bens, serviços de não consultoria e serviços de consultoria no âmbito do Projeto Integrado de Mobilidade Sustentável na Foz do Rio Itajaí (PROMOBIS). O projeto conta ainda com contrapartida local mínima no valor de US$ 30.000.000,00 (trinta milhões de Dólares), totalizando US$ 120.000.000,00 (cento e vinte milhões de Dólares) em recursos públicos. As aquisições serão conduzidas pela Unidade de Coordenação do Projeto (UCP do PROMOBIS), responsável pela gestão fiduciária e pelo cumprimento do Regulamento de Aquisições para Mutuários do IPF do Banco Mundial (5ª edição – setembro de 2023), estando abertas a todos os licitantes de países elegíveis

O objetivo do Projeto é melhorar a acessibilidade e a mobilidade de forma inclusiva e de baixa emissão em áreas selecionadas da Região da Foz do Rio Itajaí, no Estado de Santa Catarina, Brasil.´

Para atingir esse objetivo, o Projeto está estruturado em quatro Componentes:

  • Componente 1 - Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) e Melhoria do Sistema Regional de Transporte Público (BRT-AMFRI) (Recursos: US$ 66 milhões, sendo US$ 43 milhões do BIRD e US$ 23 milhões de contrapartida local): Implantação de um sistema BRT de pista exclusiva e integrado ao longo do Corredor Central e do Corredor Circular conectando os municípios de Balneário Camboriú, Camboriú, Itajaí e Navegantes; quatro corredores de ônibus de tráfego misto; rede de 70 km de intervenções de segurança viária e infraestrutura não motorizada (ciclovias, ciclofaixas e calçadas); centro de controle operacional integrado à gestão de riscos de desastres; e medidas complementares de acessibilidade e inclusão de gênero. Adicionalmente, estima-se aporte de até US$ 42 milhões de investimento privado por meio de Parcerias Público-Privadas (PPPs) para a operação do BRT e aquisição de frota elétrica.

 

  • Componente 2 - Assistência Técnica para o Túnel Fluvial proposto entre Itajaí e Navegantes (Recursos: US$ 8 milhões, sendo US$ 4 milhões do BIRD e US$ 4 milhões de contrapartida local): Estudos e assistência técnica para o projeto do túnel imerso sob o Rio Itajaí-Açú, incluindo: estudos de demanda e Matriz Origem-Destino (OD) com perspectiva de gênero e social; projetos básicos de engenharia, estudos geotécnicos e matrizes de risco; auditorias de segurança viária e de gênero; e estudos de estruturação da Parceria Público-Privada (PPP) para a concessão do túnel.

 

  • Componente 3 - Conexões de Mobilidade Ativa - Corredores de Pedestres, Rotas Escolares Seguras e Ciclovias em Balneário Camboriú (Recursos: US$ 38 milhões, sendo US$ 35 milhões do BIRD e US$ 3 milhões de contrapartida local): Investimentos em infraestrutura de mobilidade ativa para pedestres, ciclistas e usuários de micromobilidade elétrica, conectando áreas economicamente vulneráveis de Balneário Camboriú a centros de emprego e serviços na orla, com acessibilidade universal, corredores de pedestres, rotas escolares seguras e ciclovias resilientes.

 

  • Componente 4 - Apoio ao Fortalecimento Institucional e Gestão do Projeto (Recursos: US$ 8 milhões do BIRD): Apoio à Unidade de Coordenação do Projeto (UCP), incluindo o planejamento integrado regional, gestão de PPPs e concessões, fortalecimento do controle interno, plataforma de gestão de projetos, MaaS (Mobility as a Service), diagnóstico para capacitação de populações vulneráveis, monitoramento e avaliação do projeto.

As aquisições de contratos financiados pelo Banco Mundial serão realizadas de acordo com o Regulamento de Aquisições para Mutuários de Financiamento de Projetos de Investimento (IPF) do Banco Mundial e estarão abertas a todos os licitantes de países elegíveis, conforme definido nessas normas. Os métodos de seleção previstos incluem: Solicitação de Propostas (Design e Build), Solicitação de Oferta (SDO), Solicitação de Cotação (SDC), Seleção Baseada na Qualidade e Custo (SBQC), Seleção pelo Menor Custo (SMC), Seleção Baseada na Qualidade (SBQ), Seleção Baseada nas Qualificações do Consultor (SQC), Seleção Direta e Seleção de Consultores Individuais, conforme estabelecido no Plano de Aquisições do Projeto aprovado pelo Banco Mundial. Cabe destacar que a formalização de qualquer contrato somente se dará após assinatura do Contrato de Empréstimo entre o Banco Mundial e o CIM-AMFRI.

À medida que estiverem disponíveis, serão publicados Avisos Específicos de Licitação (AEL) e Avisos de Manifestação de Interesse (AMI) para contratos individuais no STEP (Systematic Tracking of Exchanges in Procurement) do Banco Mundial, no Diário Oficial e demais meios de publicidade previstos nas normas do Banco Mundial e do CIM-AMFRI, como, Diário Oficial do Estado de Santa Catarina, jornais de circulação na região da AMFRI e redes sociais do Projeto.

Os licitantes, consultores, subcontratados e seus respectivos agentes deverão observar estritamente os parágrafos 3.14 a 3.18 da Seção III do Regulamento de Aquisições para Mutuários de Operações de Financiamento de Projetos de Investimento (IPF) do Banco Mundial, 5ª edição, de setembro de 2023, que estabelecem a política do Banco Mundial sobre conflito de interesses, bem como para as regras de elegibilidade constantes dos parágrafos 3.21 a 3.24 da mesma Seção e para as disposições sobre Fraude e Corrupção previstas no Anexo IV do referido Regulamento, bem como as disposições do Código de Conduta do Projeto  (link: https://cim-amfri.sc.gov.br/pagina-45496/)

Licitantes e consultores elegíveis, interessados em ser incluídos na lista para receber solicitações de pré-qualificação, licitação ou manifestação de interesse para contratos de consultoria, bem como qualquer interessado em obter informações adicionais sobre o Projeto, poderão entrar em contato com a Unidade de Coordenação do Projeto (UCP do PROMOBIS)

Request for Expression of Interest

(Consultancy Firms)

 

 

Project Name:        West Bank and Gaza Integrated Solid Waste Management Project – Phase 1 - (ISWMP – 1)

 

Assignment:           Detailed Study on Optimizing Solid Waste Collection in the West Bank

 

MDLF has received financing in the amount of US$ 25 million equivalent from the TFGWB, and PID-MDTF toward the cost of the West Bank and Gaza Integrated Solid Waste Management – Phase I Project (ISWMP-1) and it intends to apply part of the proceeds to payments for goods, works, non-consulting services and consulting services to be procured under this project.

MDLF intends to apply part of the proceeds under the Project toward payment under the Contract “the above-mentioned assignment” (hereinafter called “the Services”).                                         

The overall objective of this assignment is to improve the efficiency, effectiveness, and sustainability of solid waste collection and transfer operations across West Bank. This will be achieved through a detailed assessment of existing solid waste collection services identifying gaps and areas for improvement across institutional, technical, operational, environmental and social, and financial management aspects and establish benchmarking with international guidelines and practices and propose/implement viable service optimization options and capacity development works, within a framework of key performance indicators.

The detailed Terms of References (TORs) for the assignments can be viewed at the website: www.MDLF.org.ps/TOR.

  1. MDLF now invites eligible firms to express their interest in providing the services. Interested firms must provide information indicating that they are qualified and have the relevant experience to perform the services.
  2. The shortlisting criteria are:
  1. General Firm’s Profile:
  • Core Business: the firm shall possess a strong background in solid waste management planning, system optimization, and institutional strengthening and carrying out detailed studies on planning and optimizing solid waste collection and management systems integrating circular economy and green practices of similar projects in nature, scale, and complexity, with working knowledge in the MENA region is a plus.
  • Years in Business: the firm must have a minimum of 10 years of experience in the field of the assignment.
  1. Qualifications in the Field of the Assignment:
  • Proven track record in successfully completing at least two (2) similar assignments within the last ten (10) years, involving solid waste management system assessment and design across the entire waste management cycle, including components related to GIS-based planning, environmental and social management.
  • Expertise in the preparation of Environmental and Social Management Systems, that includes monitoring, auditing, occupational health and safety (OHS), and institutional support.
  • Expertise in the preparation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and the preparation of detailed investment plans on strategic and on wasteshed and service area levels.
  • Expertise in the design and implementation of capacity development and training programs in SWM systems and system standardization across planning, execution, and development of technical, financial, environmental, social, and OHS aspects in accordance with recognized international standards and the World Bank’s ESS.
  • Technical and Managerial Organization: the firm uses recognized, pre-approved methodologies with track record in implementing multiple complex tasks simultaneously and managing technical teams efficiently and effectively.
  1. General Qualifications and Key Staff:
  • Availability of Qualified Staff: Staff include team leader, solid waste specialist, financial specialist, legal expert, capacity development specialist, environmental expert, social expert, health & safety, and GIS and data analysis specialist.

 

  1. MDLF draws the attention of the interested firms to the conflict of interest articles included in the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, Sixth edition dated March 2025 first published in July 2016; and the “Guidelines on Preventing and Combating Fraud and Corruption in Projects Financed by IBRD loans and IDA Credits and Grants” dated January 2011.
  2. Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.
  3. Request for Proposals (RFPs) will be sent to the shortlisted firms. Firms will be selected under Selection based on Quality-Cost Based Selection (QCBS) in accordance with the provisions of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, Sixth edition dated March 2025 first published in July 2016; and the “Guidelines on Preventing and Combating Fraud and Corruption in Projects Financed by IBRD loans and IDA Credits and Grants” dated January 2011.  
  4. Further information can be obtained from MDLF during office hours 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM from Sunday to Thursday at the address given below.
  5. Expressions of interest must be delivered to the address below on or before Thursday 09/07/2026. Late expressions will be rejected.

Section I. Invitation to Bid

Invitation to Bid for

Subproject ID No. PRDP-SU-IB-RO09-ZAS-001-000-000-2023-FMR

1. The Government of the Philippines (GOP) has received a Loan from the World Bank toward the cost of Philippine Rural Development Project Scale Up, and it intends to apply part of the proceeds of this Loan to payments under the contract for Rehabilitation/Concreting of Logan – Bacalan – Domandan – Supit – Culasian – Malagandis – New Canaan Farm to Market Road with Subproject ID No. PRDP-SU-IB-RO09-ZAS-001-000-000-2023-FMR.

2. The Provincial Government of Zamboanga Sibugay, implementing partner of the Department of Agriculture, now invites bids for the Rehabilitation/Concreting of Logan – Bacalan – Domandan – Supit – Culasian – Malagandis – New Canaan Farm to Market Road with Estimated Project Cost (EPC) in the amount of Three Hundred Forty Million Six Hundred Seventy-Seven Thousand Pesos (Php 340,677,000.00). Completion of the Works is required in 458 calendar days. Bidders should have completed, within the last ten (10) years, a contract similar to the Project. The description of an eligible bidder is contained in the Bidding Documents, particularly, in Section 5 of the Instructions to Bidders, and Sub-sections 5.2 and 5.4 of the Bid Data Sheet.

3. Bidding will be conducted in accordance with relevant procedures for open competitive bidding as specified in the Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR) of Republic Act (RA) 12009, otherwise known as the “New Government Procurement Reform Act”, with some amendments, as stated in the Bidding Documents and is open to all Bidders from eligible source countries, as defined in the World Bank Procurement Regulations. The contract shall be awarded to the Bidder that met the criteria indicated in the Bidding Documents.

4. Interested bidders may obtain further information from the Provincial Government of Zamboanga Sibugay and inspect the Bidding Documents at the address given below from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
